verdict.rationale: Docs describe a dedicated Skills API and Messages API `container` parameter for programmatically attaching Skills (with `skill_id`, versioning, up to 20 per request), plus upload/management endpoints, which constitutes an official API/SDK surface to build against. Missing for 10: explicit language-specific SDK code samples (Python/TypeScript) and independent hands-on developer reports confirming building production integrations against this API.
